_comment: Mutation testing for the security-critical auth orchestration module (lib/app-auth.ts: password/passkey/TOTP login, unlock, KDF-preloaded registration). Validates that the tests would CATCH a bug, not just execute the line. Runs in CI (.github/workflows/mutation.yml) only when this module or its tests change. `break` is a RATCHET FLOOR, not the target: the current score is ~60% (363 killed / 193 survived / 47 no-coverage of 603 mutants) because the fast killer set (app-auth + offline-auth unit tests) under-exercises the passkey / TOTP / recover-2FA / registration flows — break is set just below that to block regressions while assertions are strengthened. Raise `break` toward `low`/`high` as survivors are killed (start by adding flow tests that drive those un-covered branches). Same discipline as the coverage ratchet. Run locally: npm run mutation:auth (see reports/mutation/auth.html).
